reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Class Variance Authority (https://cva.style/).
Technology stack: javascript, typescript, css, tailwind.
Component specification: 最后开 Variants：button 的 intent、size 和 compoundVariants。

Visual details from source observation: 打开 cva.style，标题 Class Variance Authority，中间黑白几何 logo，侧栏 Introduction 到 Variants。Installation 写 pnpm i class-variance-authority，并说明 npm 短名 cva 要到 v1。Variants 页用 button 的 intent、size、compoundVariants 示范。站点薄，三页都是文档。适合要 Tailwind 变体、又不想上 CSS-in-TS 的人。Apache-2.0，赞助不是买断。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
